Class OnvistaSecuritySearch

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.BaseSecuritySearchProvider
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.OnvistaSecuritySearch
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISecuritySearchProvider
@Component public class OnvistaSecuritySearch extends BaseSecuritySearchProvider
Finds the listings of an ISIN at onvista without a key. onvista is no exchange but quotes an instrument on many trading venues - in particular the German regional exchanges and Milan, which no other provider of the lookup covers.

The search takes two requests: instruments/query names type and onvista id of the instrument, and its snapshot lists every venue with notation (market.idNotation), exchange code (market.codeExchange, e.g. GER, STU, NYS) and currency. The onvista rows of mic_provider_map place an exchange code on a GT stock exchange; venues without row, such as Tradegate or gettex, are skipped. ISIN, currency and MIC count as delivered. A bond's snapshot is requested from bonds/ISIN:…/snapshot, which adds its terms.

The provider instrument id {TYPE}/{id}/eod_history?idNotation={notation} is the URL extension of the onvista connector. The ticker is the home symbol on an exchange of the instrument's home country and the onvista symbol elsewhere (Apple: AAPL on Nasdaq, APC in Frankfurt); a bond on a German venue has the WKN as ticker.
